trust_assumptions.statement: Owners are trusted to choose oracle/spender/router, relax slippage and floors, transfer ownership, rescue unprotected tokens and invoke adminDexSwap. Owner compromise is not excluded from privilege inventory.

MYT alone enters allocate/deallocate and pulls exactly approved assets after deallocation. Vault allocation(adapterId) is the old tracked value. Tests must reproduce the post-call pull before conservation assertions.

Ordinary conservation proofs assume standard ERC20 exact transfers, stable decimals and meaningful balanceOf. Fee/rebase/false-return/reentrant mocks test adapter responses but do not prove arbitrary-token compatibility.

Aave, Moonwell, ERC4626/Yearn, Curve, StakeDAO, Tokemak, Ether.fi, InfiniFi, Frax and Lido contracts are external boundaries. Mocks expose explicit return, error, fee and conversion relations. Real deployments/upgrades remain unverified.
Conversion mocks must preserve actual floor/ceil unit relations. Do not assume a target cap or conservation assertion merely to make the proof pass.
Positive/fresh feed validation does not establish fair prices or underlying freshness for synthetic timestamp feeds. Oracle decimals and answer magnitude have no configured upper bounds.
Router calldata is opaque and entered only through vault/owner paths. Local balance and allowance checks constrain outcomes. Toke NAV minimum depends on external router minOut enforcement.
Default amount<=1e27, price/rate<=1e24 and enumerated decimals are verification domains, not enforced protocol limits. Report all omitted values and boundary failures.

threats.description: Unauthorized configuration, allocation, deallocation, reward claim or rescue. Check actual entrypoints and exact revert selectors with valid positive-call witnesses.
Signed allocation wrap, missing idle or staked value, incorrect denomination, nonconserving external outputs, fee mismatch and rounding theft.
Stale/zero/future feed data, synthetic freshness, oracle depeg, extreme decimals/price and manipulated Curve quotes.
Allowance left after success, output below minimum, oversold receipt balance, force-deallocation swap bypass, malformed calldata, external reentry and reward-balance confusion.
Illiquid withdrawal, partial external redemption, zero exchange rate, oversized fees, idle fast-path behavior and dust rounding.
SiUSD unwrap returns all idle iUSD, which can exceed maxOracleTokenIn even though requested minimum is capped. Source candidate only; needs actual bytecode counterexample.
Etherfi does not override _isProtectedToken, so owner can rescue weETH/eETH. Characterize as privileged principal access, not an unauthorized-user exploit.
Toke direct exit passes NAV floor to router but local output check only enforces shortfall. Counterexample possible with hostile router ignoring minOut; classify against trust model.
Base allocation differences cast unbounded uint256 valuations to int256. Test high-bit boundaries and resulting vault integration separately.

limitations: No tests or solver runs occurred in this Phase 2 source analysis. All properties are proposals; no safety claim follows.
The graph CLI and graft/INDEX.md are unavailable according to root discovery. Direct source reads cover all owned implementation files.
Do not use reference examples as integer equivalences: a/b<=c is not equivalent to a<=b*c. Preserve quotients/remainders, exact rounding and overflow guards.
An INLINE result is a model lemma until actual bytecode equivalence is established. Differential fuzz is empirical evidence, not a formal refinement proof.
Positive success witnesses and exact custom-error assertions prevent tests from passing only because mocks or malformed ABI cause unrelated reverts.
One symbolic execution path can represent many inputs; path count alone cannot establish vacuity. Audit satisfiable assumptions, actual assertions and meaningful state transitions.
No P0 function coverage can be inferred from a constructor/getter test alone. A guarded function needs its own selector exercised, and child internal flows need entrypoint coverage.
Full dependency implementations, mainnet liquidity, oracle price truth, arbitrary decimal values and all external route array sizes remain outside bounded mock proofs unless separately tested.
